what: same-item retrieval quality: a model-independent target for comparing embedders

task.relevant: other passages of the probe's own Zotero item, at least 3 chunks away
task.excluded_from_candidates: the probe's own item's passages within 3 chunks of it
task.why_the_gap: the chunker overlaps by 150 characters, so adjacent chunks share text outright and any embedder retrieves them; without the gap this measures near-duplicate detection and saturates

caveats: Same-item relatedness is document-level topical coherence, not query-to-answer relevance. This proxy can show a model is too weak; it cannot certify one is good enough for a user’s real questions.
Recall is divided by min(relevant, topk), so an item with more than topk eligible siblings is not penalised for the ones that cannot fit.
Comparing two DIFFERENT models here conflates dimension with architecture, size and training data. Only the widths WITHIN one Matryoshka model isolate dimension.
